lines.text: Troubled by dreams in his second year, Nebuchadnezzar summoned his wise men and demanded both the dream and its interpretation.
Furious, the king ordered all the wise men destroyed, so Daniel asked for time and told Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
Daniel went to Arioch, who hastily brought him before the king as a man among the exiles from Egypt.
Daniel described a statue with a golden head and iron legs, struck by a stone that became a great sea.
The king fell on his face before Daniel, made him ruler over Babylon's province, and appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.
